skill.summary: Uno CLI — Agent Tool Gateway via command line. 2000+ real-world tools accessible with two commands: search → call. Features Device Code OAuth (via ClawdChat...

latestVersion.changelog: Reposition the skill from 'broad tool gateway' to 'on-demand scoped tool client': agent searches → previews with call --dry-run (credential-free, zero-network, zero-credit preview) → shows the preview JSON to the user → only then runs the real call. Description rewritten to emphasise the narrow search-dry-run-confirm-call workflow. Requires uno-cli>=1.0.2 on PyPI which implements the --dry-run mode.
